name: modulate-setup
description: Set up or repair a Modulate Mac companion and Raspberry Pi connection with your coding agent.

interface.shortDescription: Connect your Mac, Raspberry Pi, and Modulate.
interface.longDescription: Portable setup guidance for your coding agent. Inspects an existing Modulate installation, prepares the companion and Pi runtime, and guides the human steps for pairing and macOS permissions. No credentials, background hooks, or automatic native installation are bundled.
defaultPrompt: Use $modulate-setup to connect my Mac and Raspberry Pi, preserving my existing apps and settings.
